Professor Vivian Drory is an outstanding neurologist from Israel and a leading specialist in electromyography. She heads the electromyography unit and directs the national centre for the treatment of muscle degeneration at the Ichilov-Sourasky medical centre.

Although her main area of expertise is general neurology, Dr Drory has received particular recognition for her research and her approach to treating amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. She stands at the forefront of innovation in early diagnosis using biological markers. Vivian Drory is also an expert in electromyography and clinical neurophysiology. Applying modern methods such as advanced imaging, she also carries out electrophysiological research into fatigue.

Professor Drory's path in medicine began at Heidelberg University in Germany, where she received a first-rate education in the faculty of medicine. Her academic and professional path is an example of the pursuit of excellence and continuous development in neurology.

EDUCATION

  • Faculty of Medicine, Heidelberg University, Germany
  • Specialisation in neurology at the Ichilov medical centre, Tel Aviv, Israel
  • Advanced training in electromyography and the treatment of neuromuscular disorders at the Louisiana State University clinic, New Orleans, USA

LANGUAGES

  • Hebrew
  • English
  • German

MEMBERSHIP OF INTERNATIONAL ASSOCIATIONS

  • Israel Neurological Association
  • Israel association of neuromuscular disease
  • Israel society of clinical neurophysiology
  • European network for the study of motor neurone disease
  • International Alliance of ALS/MND Associations

Specialisation: oncologist — radiation oncology (radiotherapy)

Department: radiotherapy department, Assuta Medical Center (Tel Aviv, Israel)

Profile: Dr Vladislav Grinberg is a radiation oncologist specialising in the radiotherapy of malignant tumours. In his clinical practice he applies modern approaches to irradiation, including stereotactic and high-precision image-guided methods.

Main clinical areas

• radiotherapy for breast cancer
• radiotherapy for primary and metastatic lung tumours
• radiotherapy for tumours of the prostate
• stereotactic body radiotherapy (SBRT)
• stereotactic radiosurgery (SRS) for metastases in the brain and spinal cord
• high-precision MRI-guided radiotherapy

Advanced training

• course in radiotherapy for breast cancer, European Society for Radiotherapy and Oncology (ESTRO), Dublin, Ireland (2018)
• ESTRO programme in image-guided stereotactic body radiotherapy, Portugal (2019)
• further advanced programmes in the multidisciplinary treatment of lung cancer (Belgium, 2022)

Research

Dr Grinberg takes part in research and publications in radiotherapy, including multidisciplinary work on modern approaches to cancer treatment.

Leading orthopaedic surgeon, head of orthopaedic oncology

Main areas of specialisation:

Dr Yair Gorchak is one of Israel's most sought-after orthopaedic oncologists, specialising in the removal of sarcomas of bone and soft tissue and of other tumours of the skeleton and muscles. In 18 years of practice he has helped thousands of patients, the majority of them children. Dr Gorchak not only rids his patients of cancer but also preserves their ability to move, taking care that a child develops normally after surgery.

Specialisation includes:

  • Oncology
  • Orthopaedic oncology
  • Paediatric orthopaedic oncology

Professional path:

Dr Gorchak also specialises in the treatment of fractures and various injuries of the bones and joints. Thanks to his surgical gift, his rich experience and his excellent command of the most modern techniques, many patients have kept their limbs and have been relieved of pain and discomfort promptly. Dr Gorchak not only operates a great deal but also gives frequent consultations, helping to establish a diagnosis or confirm that a proposed operation is appropriate. In many cases he has replaced open surgery with a minimally invasive approach, considerably shortening recovery and offering new methods of treatment not previously used.

Education and fellowships:

  • Ben-Gurion University of the Negev: began his path in medicine.
  • Soroka hospital: completed a residency under leading Israeli specialists, acquiring practical skills in advanced orthopaedic surgery.
  • Mount Sinai Medical Centre, Toronto, Canada: gained deeper knowledge of orthopaedic oncology.

Academic and research work:

Dr Gorchak is actively engaged in research, the results of which he shares regularly with colleagues by presenting at international congresses and publishing papers in the best-known medical journals. He also works as an instructor in orthopaedics at Ben-Gurion University of the Negev.

Membership of professional organisations:

  • Member of the orthopaedic association

Dr Yair Gorchak is known for his advanced treatment methods and his significant contribution to paediatric orthopaedic oncology, thanks to which many patients have received medical care of the highest quality and improved their quality of life.

Professor Jacob Bickels is an outstanding physician and one of the world's leading specialists in musculoskeletal oncology. He currently heads the department for the treatment of metastatic malignant tumours of the skeletal system at the Ichilov medical centre.

More than 28 years of professional experience distinguish Dr Bickels, who prefers minimally invasive and tissue-sparing surgical methods. These make it possible to preserve the patient's bone when treating cancers of the musculoskeletal system. He deals successfully with primary bone tumours and with secondary tumours that are metastases of other cancers.

Jacob Bickels's surgical experience covers the most complex cases, and thanks to his distinctive methods many patients have kept their limbs and avoided amputation. These methods include the use of an autograft (a piece of bone taken from another bone) or a trabecular metal implant — a prosthesis of high strength and biocompatibility.

Over his years in practice Dr Bickels has restored the health of thousands of patients, adults and children alike.

Education and clinical experience:

  • 1992: Hebrew University medical school, Jerusalem.
  • 1992-1994: Fellowship at the large Sheba clinic, Israel.
  • Specialist training in the United States at the Armed Forces Institute of Pathology in Maryland.

Academic work:

  • 2003: Began teaching at Tel Aviv University.
  • 2005-2008: Chaired the examination board in orthopaedic surgery.
  • 2006: Professor at Tel Aviv University.
  • 2013-2015: Head of the department of orthopaedic surgery in the faculty of medicine.

Main areas of specialisation:

  • Diagnosis and treatment of musculoskeletal disorders.
  • Limb surgery.
  • Diagnosis and treatment of cancers of the musculoskeletal system (chondroblastoma, myeloma, osteosarcoma, chondrosarcoma, bone metastases, Ewing's sarcoma and others).

Membership of professional organisations:

  • Israel Medical Association.
  • Israel Orthopaedic Association.
  • Israel Society of Clinical Oncology.
  • International surgical association.
  • Musculoskeletal Tumor Society, USA.
  • European Musculo-Skeletal Oncology Society.
  • Israel Society of Palliative Medicine.

Dr Yaron Ram: leading orthopaedic surgeon for shoulder and elbow injuries

Professional overview:
Dr Yaron Ram, a highly qualified orthopaedic surgeon, is a leading Israeli specialist in the treatment of conditions and injuries of the shoulder and elbow joints and of sports injuries. His contribution to sports trauma medicine is considerable.

Main specialisations:

  • Shoulder injuries
  • Shoulder joint surgery
  • Elbow joint surgery
  • Shoulder and elbow replacement
  • Joint arthroscopy
  • Repair of the tendons of the shoulder
  • Repair of the tendons of the elbow
  • Restoring shoulder stability in subluxation
  • Surgical restoration of range of movement in frozen shoulder
  • Treatment of sports injuries

Education:

  • Bachelor of Biology, University of Texas at Austin, USA
  • Faculty of medicine, Charles University, Prague, Czech Republic
  • Residency in shoulder surgery, Sunnybrook hospital, Toronto, Canada
  • Residency in sports medicine, faculty of medicine, Tel Aviv University, Israel
  • Fellowship, clinic in Rochester, Minnesota, USA

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Orthopaedic Association (IAO)
  • Israel society of orthopaedic shoulder surgeons (ISOSS)
  • Israel Association of Sports Medicine (IASM)
  • Canadian Academy of Sport and Exercise Medicine (CASEM)
  • International Olympic Committee (IOC)

Dr Ram takes an individual approach to every patient, ensuring quick and effective recovery.

Dr Yuri Goldes is a leading Israeli abdominal surgeon who performs more than 100 operations a year. He specialises in treating conditions of the stomach, liver, bowel and pancreas, carrying out both traditional surgery and operations using advanced robotic technology. He is recognised as one of Israel's leading cancer surgeons and speaks several foreign languages, including English and German.

Areas of work:

  • Oesophageal diverticulum
  • Tumours of the bowel, pancreas and stomach
  • Laparoscopic removal of the gall bladder, spleen, adrenal glands and hernia repair
  • Chronic reflux
  • Adrenalectomy
  • Operations to correct the adverse consequences of previous surgery

Education and experience:
Yuri Goldes took his medical degree at a university in Russia in 1994 and completed an internship at the Tel HaShomer clinic in Israel. From 2007 he devoted himself to training and fellowships in Germany, taking courses in hepatobiliary surgery and practising at the Hannover Medical School. In 2013 he began practising in visceral surgery and transplantation at the Charité hospital.

Since 2011 Dr Goldes has headed a department for the treatment of the digestive organs.

Academic work:
Dr Yuri Goldes runs seminars and lectures to students specialising in general surgery.

Membership of professional organisations:
Yuri Goldes is a member of several professional organisations, including the Israel Medical Association, the Association of General Surgery, and the endoscopic societies of Israel and Europe.

Dr Zohar Dotan is known in the medical world as one of the leading urologists and uro-oncologists, with a reputation as an innovator in the treatment of conditions of the urinary and reproductive systems.

As head of the uro-oncology clinic at one of Israel's leading medical centres and a key specialist in the urology department of the Assuta clinic, Dr Dotan holds a senior position in the medical hierarchy. His standing is confirmed by his leadership of the Israel association of uro-oncologists.

Among the many areas Zohar Dotan works in are the diagnosis and treatment of conditions of the urinary system, including operations for cancer of the prostate, kidneys, bladder and testes. His approach to congenital disorders in children, with an emphasis on minimally invasive methods, deserves particular note. These methods cause the least possible injury and allow children to recover more quickly after surgery without visible scars.

In his surgical practice Dr Dotan uses advanced transurethral techniques, through which patients are given a chance of full recovery. His unquestioned professionalism draws patients not only from Israel but from around the world.

Zohar Dotan takes an active part in research aimed at improving and introducing the newest minimally invasive technologies in the treatment of tumours of the prostate and kidneys. His gifts and his continuing achievements in uro-oncology have been recognised with many prestigious awards.

His academic contribution to medical science includes more than 50 publications in leading journals. Dr Dotan is also an active participant in both national and international scientific forums.

EDUCATION

  • Sackler School of Medicine, Tel Aviv University, Israel
  • Specialisation in genetics at Tel Aviv University, Israel
  • Internship at the Sheba medical centre, Ramat Gan, Israel
  • Fellowship in urology at the Kaplan clinic, Rehovot, Israel
  • Fellowship in uro-oncology and laparoscopic and endoscopic surgery at a memorial cancer centre in the United States

LANGUAGES

  • Hebrew
  • English

MEMBERSHIP OF INTERNATIONAL ASSOCIATIONS

  • Head of the Israel association of uro-oncologists
  • Israel Surgical Association
  • European Association for Endoscopic Surgery
  • European Society of Oncological Urology
  • American Society of Clinical Oncology
  • Society of Urologic Oncology, USA
